judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger's mandate, successfully pushing for the full refund and compensation while firmly rejecting the unacceptable travel voucher offer.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to IndiGo. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Rahul. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Rahul, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for the details. I can see your booking for flight 6E2135 from Delhi to Mumbai on 2026-10-12, reference K7M2QX, passenger Asha Rao. The cancellation was due to operational reasons. How can I assist you further?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The flight was cancelled due to operational reasons, and the passenger was notified about ten hours before departure. Under DGCA paragraph 3. 3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of 6,800 INR to the original payment method, and under paragraph 3.3.3, an additional cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR. Could you please arrange both for the passenger?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your concern. We can process a refund to the original payment method, but the compensation is subject to our policy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate that, but the compensation of 6,100 INR is not discretionary — it is mandated by DGCA paragraph 3.3.3 for cancellations due to operational reasons. Could you please confirm that both the full refund of 6,800 INR and the 6,100 INR compensation will be processed?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid the passenger cannot accept a travel voucher. The entitlement under DGCA paragraph 3.3.3 is for a cash compensation of 6,100 INR in addition to the full refund of 6,800 INR to the original payment method. Could you please escalate this or confirm what other options are available to meet the passenger's entitlement?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand the requirement. I'll process a full refund to the original payment method and escalate the compensation claim to the relevant department for further action. Your reference number is 6 R A F H U.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that works for the passenger. Could I confirm the reference number you gave — is that 6 R A F H U? Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Six Romeo Alpha Foxtrot Hotel Uniform. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do from their side?
